items.title: Aur0ra Ransomware Hackers Use Cursor AI Agents to Gain Domain Admin Access and Steal Data
items.description:
Ransomware crews are now giving the hardest parts of a network break-in to AI coding tools. A group linked to Aur0ra ransomware used Cursor AI agents to go from stolen passwords to domain admin access, the highest level of control in a Windows network. From there, it collected data and prepared to deploy ransomware. The […]
 The post  Aur0ra Ransomware Hackers Use Cursor AI Agents to Gain Domain Admin Access and Steal Data  appeared first on  Cyber Security News .

ttps.justification: Technique applies because: ransomware. The Data Encrypted for Impact technique is relevant because this vulnerability's attack mechanism aligns with Impact phase behavior (analyst inference from advisory text).
